title: Douglas rejects the NWA and declares ECW extreme
summary: Shane Douglas becomes the central champion of ECW’s transformation. His rejection of the NWA belt turns an established title tournament into a statement of independence.

chapters.title: Douglas regains ECW’s title
chapters.result: Douglas wins the ECW Heavyweight championship from Funk in the team cage match.
chapters.context: This reign begins months before its later elevation to world-title status.

chapters.title: The NWA belt is thrown down
chapters.result: Douglas defeats Scorpio, rejects the NWA championship and proclaims ECW’s world title.
chapters.context: The angle precedes ECW’s formal renaming from Eastern to Extreme Championship Wrestling.
